name: Beta Glass
source: Beta Glass Plc unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), group column, N'000 scaled to NGN. Net finance costs combine the printed net finance expense with the foreign exchange loss printed above it so the column ties from operating profit to profit before tax. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column from the Beta Glass Plc interim statement of profit or loss for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, NGX doclib, nine months column, printed in N thousand and stored as absolute naira. Revenue 120,083,285; cost of sales 76,828,406; gross profit 43,254,879; selling and distribution 429,603 plus administrative 5,840,566 gives operating expenses 6,270,169; printed operating profit 39,254,843 includes a credit loss reversal of 292,274 and other income of 1,977,859; net finance result 373,557; profit before taxation 37,640,599; income tax 12,713,973; profit after tax 24,926,626; EPS printed 41.55 naira. Ties exactly on both identities.
